from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        swc = operator.StarWithCoordinator(worker_llm=self.llm, coordinator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, worker_prompts=["{problem}\n\nFollow the directive exactly:\n{directive}"] * 3, coordinator_prompt=prompt_custom.TTT_COORDINATOR_PROMPT, n_rounds=2)
        draft = await swc(problem)
        seq = operator.Sequential(llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=1, prompts=[prompt_custom.TTT_FORMATTER_PROMPT])
        solution = await seq((draft["response"] or "```\\n\"\" \"\" \"\"\\n\"\" \"\" \"\"\\n\"\" \"\" \"\"\\n```") + "\n\nOriginal problem:\n" + problem)
        worker_usage = self.llm.get_usage_delta()
        aggregator_usage = {"total_input_tokens": 0, "total_output_tokens": 0, "total_cost": 0.0} if self.aggregator_llm is self.llm else self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta()
        return solution["response"] or "```\n\"\" \"\" \"\"\n\"\" \"\" \"\"\n\"\" \"\" \"\"\n```", {"worker": worker_usage, "aggregator": aggregator_usage}
